fields.label: Database Roles
fields.help: A list of database roles to be assigned to the user.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Host
fields.help: The host the user can connect from.

fields.label: Instance
fields.help: The name of the Cloud SQL instance.

fields.label: Project
fields.help: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.

fields.label: Allowed Failed Attempts
fields.help: Number of failed attempts allowed before the user get locked.

fields.label: Enable Failed Attempts Check
fields.help: If true, the check that will lock user after too many failed login attempts will be enabled.

fields.label: Enable Password Verification
fields.help: If true, the user must specify the current password before changing the password.

fields.label: Password Expiration Duration
fields.help: Password expiration duration with one week grace period.
